name: liaison
description: Arrange a briefed, two-way voice conversation between a human and an AI session, then bring structured findings back into the agent's workstream — the agent syncs the docs, frames the talk for voice, and seeds a chat to continue on mobile. Powered by aichatctl.

interface.shortDescription: Briefed voice conversation with a human, findings back.
interface.longDescription: An agent skill that acts as a liaison: when work is blocked on a decision or needs human feedback, it syncs the relevant docs into a project, frames a voice conversation for spoken interaction, seeds a chat the human continues by voice, and relays a structured findings markdown back so the agent can resume. Powered by aichatctl.
